title: Rural baseball gives Mastin 200th career win in 14-1 romp past Gardner-Edgerton - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago The Washburn Rural baseball team gave coach Jay Mastin his 200th career victory in a 14-1 home romp over Gardner-Edgerton in the Junior Blues’ season-opener Tuesday. Rural senior pitcher Isaac Ansley spun five efficient innings, which were a sharp contrast to the opponent. The visiting Trailblazers’ parade of hurlers were crippled by free passes and balks, compounded by shaky defense behind them. The Junior Blues produced 14 runs on just eight hits, only one of which went for extra bases. Read full article
